label: TP
reason: Single java/xss alert verified as true positive. User input from request parameter flows through getTheParameter() to param, then to bar via doSomething(), then into obj array, finally written to response.getWriter().format() without HTML encoding. Substring truncation in doSomething() does not mitigate XSS (payload survives minus last char). Resolved sink value includes attacker-controlled data. X-XSS-Protection header set to '0' disables browser defense.

evidence.note: User parameter flows to bar via doSomething(), then into obj array, written unsafely to response writer. No encoding applied. Resolved sink value contains attacker-controlled data from param.
